name: Canaletto
contribution: An Italian painter from the Republic of Venice, considered an important member of the 18th-century Venetian school.
legacy: Painter of cityscapes or vedute, of Venice, Rome, and London, he also painted imaginary views, although the demarcation in his works between the real and the imaginary is never quite clearcut.

checks.lead: Giovanni Antonio Canal (18 October 1697 – 19 April 1768), commonly known as Canaletto (Italian: [kanaˈletto]), was an Italian painter from the Republic of Venice, considered an important member of the 18th-century Venetian school.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
